name: Belfast

queries.query: Belfast official cadastral parcel map land registry GIS Northern Ireland Land and Property Services Spatial NI
queries.result: First-party discovery identified Land & Property Services (LPS) as the Northern Ireland Land Registry custodian, the official Land Registry map description, the official statement that online public Land Registry searching is not currently available, and the public Spatial NI/OSNI viewer. No anonymous parcel feature service with safe native IDs and full polygons was verified.
queries.scope: Identify Belfast/Northern Ireland registry custody and an anonymous public parcel geometry source without requesting owner, address, title, contact, tax/account, personal data or credentials.

officialSources.operator: Land & Property Services, Department of Finance, Northern Ireland
officialSources.observation: Official page states that the Land Registry map indicates the location of registered holdings and describes digital-map updates and folio boundaries; it also cautions that boundaries are not guaranteed.
officialSources.scope: Local/national Northern Ireland registry custodian and map documentation; not an open vector endpoint.

officialSources.observation: Official public guidance identifies LPS as responsible for the Northern Ireland Land Registry and says online searching is not possible at present; searches are requested by email, telephone or in person.
officialSources.scope: Public access procedure and registry custody; no parcel geometry response.

officialSources.operator: Ordnance Survey of Northern Ireland / Spatial NI
officialSources.observation: Official Spatial NI page links the free public map viewer and identifies OSNI as the official producer of Northern Ireland mapping.
officialSources.scope: Public mapping platform; viewer configuration was followed, but no parcel layer with safe full geometry was verified.

officialSources.observation: Anonymous public GET returned the current Hub HTML/configuration. It exposed the public Hub and general map-viewer entry point, but no anonymous Belfast parcel feature service, schema, CRS, or stable parcel-ID response was identified.
officialSources.scope: Public viewer entry point and configuration inspection; not verified parcel geometry.
